 After a regular southern storm system gave much of Central and Southern New York a combination of rain and snow with some heavy accumulations over sections of Otsego and Chenango counties at elevations over 1500 feet, the forecast for the weekend remains substandard.
 It's part of our next weather makers :
 Central New York's next weather makers 
Temperatures and wind chills will remain cold right through the weekend, At the same time, precipitation will be likely through the weekend, although not necessarily raining or snowing all of the time.
In short, I am expecting a large spray of flurries and sprinkles to occur with thin bands of slightly steadier rain or wet snow showers. However, there will be two periods when the precipitation will likely be stronger and steadier.
 The best chance for steadier rain, snow and/or graupel showers will be :
--Roughly between the pre-dawn hours Saturday through late morning.
--Roughly late Saturday afternoon through Sunday morning.
While these weather makers are different than the storm system that moved through Thursday through Friday morning, due to borderline temperatures, I once again believe that snow accumulations will be different from place to place.
--Higher elevations will see higher new snow amounts where steadier snow occurs.
--Higher amounts will occur on trees, lawns, decks, and vehicles versus roadways that will see less due to borderline temperatures.
 My forecast for new snow for Friday night through Saturday morning :
 Forecast for new snow Friday night through Saturday morning for much of Upstate NY

There will still be a wealth of cloud coverage leftover on Monday with a few intervals of sunshine trying to move in.
Thereafter, the weather pattern becomes much nicer and sunnier for many days ahead next week!
